thread:
sam: spotted a Vault KV entry that references a KMS-wrapped blob in a partner upload path. path: secret/data/partners/partner-x/ingest-key -> contains ciphertext marker 'CiQ' in value.

lee: can you paste the object path and the Vault metadata?

sam: vault kv get -format=json secret/data/partners/partner-x/ingest-key -> value: {"db_key_enc":"CiQA...base64...=="} 
Looks like someone stored the wrapped ciphertext directly in Vault under a partner-scoped path that partners can read. Not good.

anita: severity: treat as exposed. Partners have read on that path as part of onboarding. We need: 1) immediately revoke partner read on that path, 2) rotate the credential, 3) provision a new KMS key and rewrap, 4) update partner to pull the new wrapped blob.

sec-bot: @sam flagged secret: secret/data/partners/partner-x/ingest-key -> potential exposed ciphertext. Severity: high.

infra-oncall: agree with steps. I'll apply a temporary Vault policy patch to remove partner role from that path (short lived). Sam, can you coordinate partner communications?

sam: yes. pinging partner-eng to pause ingestion and not to access current secret. Also creating incident INC-2026-0605.

lee: questions about KMS: do we know which cryptoKey was used to wrap? check the ciphertext header and logs to find kms key id. If the partner had only read access to Vault but no KMS decrypt, risk is lower, but assume worst.

sam: looked at ciphertext: prefix indicates key resource projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/partner-ingest-key. I'll run KMS audit query for decrypt calls in last 60d.

anita: while that runs, plan rotation: create new SA for partner ingestion, create new DB creds or rotate existing app user, create a fresh cryptoKey in a new keyring (partners-rotate-0605), rewrap and put new ciphertext behind a new Vault path secret/data/partners/partner-x/ingest-key-v2 with partner read revoked then re-granted to only the new SA.

lee: also do RBAC hardening: remove roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter from any principals tagged as partner. We'll run an IAM audit and snapshot current bindings before changing.

infra-oncall: doing IAM snapshot now. Command: gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/partner-ingest-key --format=json > /tmp/policy-2851230000.json

sec-bot: audit note: partner principal partner-eng@partner-x.iam.gserviceaccount.com appears in Vault policy as a member with read on secret/data/partners/partner-x/*

sam: partner-eng acknowledges. They've paused pushes and will not access current secret. Asking for a 2-hour maintenance window.

lee: rotation commands (sketch):
```
# create new keyring and key
gcloud kms keyrings create partners-rotate-0605 --location=global || true
gcloud kms keys create partner-rotate-0605-key --location=global --keyring=partners-rotate-0605 --purpose=encryption
# create new SA for partner
gcloud iam service-accounts create partner-ingest-rotated --project=redwood-prod
# create key for SA
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/partner-rotate-key.json --iam-account=partner-ingest-rotated@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# wrap the key
gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=partners-rotate-0605 --key=partner-rotate-0605-key --plaintext-file=/tmp/partner-rotate-key.json --ciphertext-file=/tmp/partner-rotate-key.json.enc
# push to vault
vault kv put secret/data/partners/partner-x/ingest-key-v2 db_key_enc=@/tmp/partner-rotate-key.json.enc
```

anita: policy change for Vault: temporarily revoke partner read on secret/data/partners/partner-x/* and grant vault:read only to service accounts in allowlist. We'll also enable ACL audit for Vault to log reads for 90 days.

lee: KMS audit result: no Decrypt operations by partner principals in last 60 days. Only internal runbooks and our CI used Decrypt. Still rotate key and revoke old key's IAM bindings.

infra-oncall: applied temporary Vault policy at 09:14 PT, removed partner principal. Logged change CHG-285123-VAULT-LOCK.

sam: partner confirmed pause. Starting rotate at 09:30 PT.

lee: after wrap, do validation: partner should be given a timed credential to fetch the new ciphertext (pre-signed URL to staging bucket) OR a one-time push via secure channel. Avoid re-granting Vault read until we've verified partner's ingestion code does not leak wrapped blobs.

anita: post-rotate checklist: 1) revoke old SA keys and disable old SA IAM bindings 2) update onboarding docs to forbid storing wrapped ciphertext in partner-visible Vault paths 3) add detection rule: scan Vault partner namespaces for base64 strings with KMS header prefix 4) add automated PR lint for partner infra repos to fail if any wrapped ciphertext appears in artifacts.

infra-oncall: rotation completed at 10:06 PT. new key created and ciphertext stored at ingest-key-v2. Old key IAM bindings revoked. Old SA keys disabled.

sam: partner validated reading new wrapped blob via secure channel. They completed a staged pull and smoke test. No errors.

sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-0605 status -> rotation complete. Follow-ups queued: SEC-285A (detection rule), DOC-285B (onboarding update), INFRA-285C (pre-publish lint).

lee: closing notes: no evidence partner decrypted any ciphertext, but exposure window existed while artifact was readable. Recommend mandatory partner on-boarding checklist update and a partner-facing runbook for secret handling.

sam: created follow-up tickets and scheduled a retro with partner for next Wednesday. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
